rule: Fill-path only, mapped by sheet geometry: each join targets the fillable cell whose printed caption (from the frozen page text layer) sits directly left of or above it, or the printed item number on its row. Money amounts pair the 12-slot peso comb with the 2-slot centavo comb directly right (money_joins); the 2-slot is the centavo comb for items 15-26 and Part IV 31-61. Items 1, 3, 5, 6, 13 and 14 Yes/No or option pairs take xbox_joins (box immediately left of the printed option; the first layout key of a Yes/No pair is Yes). Rows of Schedule 1, Schedule 3 and Schedule 4 print no row number and stay blank. Item 4 return period dates are three combs under one key and stay blank. Stamped TIN and branch combs (name=) take no join.
